changelog:
v0.4.0
- Add the versioned in-process Jellix bridge for search, submission, status and progress
- Share request planning, source policy, limits, duplicate checks and persistence between HTTP and Jellix
- Add user-bound, short-lived one-time selection tokens without exposing MediaForge URLs
- Add bridge contract, isolation, concurrency and security regression tests
description: Searches the movie and TV sources enabled in MediaForge directly from Jellyfin. Users can request downloads; administrators can approve them or enable automatic mode.
name: MediaForge Requests
overview: MediaForge search and download requests for all Jellyfin users
